text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups. To prevent this, fairness must be a priority when designing these systems. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should also be transparent about how their algorithms work. Responsible AI development means putting people first and making sure technology benefits everyone equally.
